reason: Imports upstream's nullable max reasoning effort billing multiplier and replaces only its new positive-value check constraint. The deployed compatibility release neither reads this column nor depends on this constraint.
risk: ALTER TABLE and validation of the new check acquire locks on channel_model_pricing. A pre-existing non-positive value from a partial manual application would fail validation; no application column or data is dropped.
mitigation: Ship the original upstream migration separately from application code. Existing rows receive NULL and satisfy the check; NULL remains valid for writes by the old image during the deployment overlap. Verify active-image ancestry and migration success before switching traffic.
approved_by: Codex automated review for upstream update requested by hang
